> [!WARNING]
> **Privacy Notice**: Never post personal API keys, unredacted settings exports (`.json`), precise street or home GPS coordinates, IP addresses, or account credentials in public issues. Use generic locations (e.g. Tokyo, London) and mock keys when reporting issues.

### Environment Details
- **Local Wally Version**: [e.g. v0.14.0 (check bottom-right of HUD or press `D` on desktop)]
- **Lively Wallpaper Version**: [e.g. v2.1.0.8]
- **Windows Version & Build**: [e.g. Windows 11 Pro 23H2 (Build 22631)]
- **WebView2 Runtime Version**: [if known, or check Diagnostics via `D`]
- **Display Resolution & Scale**: [e.g. 1920x1080 @ 100%, 2560x1440 @ 125%]

### Selected Providers & Settings
- **Weather Telemetry Provider**: [e.g. Open-Meteo (Keyless) / WeatherAPI.com / OpenWeatherMap]
- **Air Quality Provider**: [e.g. Open-Meteo AQI / WAQI]
- **News Provider**: [e.g. Auto / Google News / NewsAPI / Currents]
- **Wallpaper Provider**: [e.g. Unsplash / Wallhaven / Pexels / Pixabay]
- **Location Mode**: [e.g. Automatic IP / Manual City]

### Describe the Issue
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Actual Behavior
What actually happened (e.g. clock frozen, error label shown, layout clipped).

### Steps to Reproduce
1. In Lively Wallpaper, set Local Wally as active wallpaper.
2. ...
3. ...
